title.zh: 狼苍艾 · 蓄剪交棒与展旗传递
title.en: Ellen / Lycaon / Soukaku · scissors and flag transfer

summary.zh: 提前积急冻与涡流，莱卡恩刷新减抗，展旗后由艾莲接窗口。
summary.en: Build Charges/Vortex first, refresh Lycaon’s debuff, then transfer the window through Fly the Flag.

conditions.zh: 本方案使用未启用潜能觉醒的基础艾莲技能，不加入霜风等觉醒变招。
conditions.en: This uses Ellen’s base skills without Awakening; awakened follow-ups such as Frost Wind are excluded.

conditions.zh: 按苍角→艾莲→莱卡恩的循环站位；快支仍须匹配真实提示。
conditions.en: Use the cyclic order Soukaku → Ellen → Lycaon; Quick Assists still require matching prompts.

conditions.zh: 早期资料只保留经固定机制核对的动作；连携次数与终结技均按实际状态。
conditions.en: Only actions cross-checked against fixed mechanics are retained from early guides. Chain count and Ultimate readiness follow actual state.

label.zh: 大番茄 · 艾莲苍角传递
boyue游戏达人 · 蓄剪交棒
許可 · 支援站位说明

objective.zh: 剪击备充能，趁续招准备减抗与展旗。
objective.en: Prepare charges with scissors, then set up debuffs and Fly the Flag.

title.zh: 巡游蓄剪，出招后可交棒
title.en: Roaming charged scissors: hand off after release

input.zh: 进入巡游，长按普攻蓄满，松开让剪击发动。
input.en: Enter Roaming, fully charge held Basic, then release to start the scissor strike.

trigger.zh: 需要急冻充能，目标可命中；蓄力尚未完成时不能提前切。
trigger.en: Flash Freeze Charges are needed and the target is hittable. Do not switch before charging finishes.

complete.zh: 蓄力完成并松开发动后再切莱卡恩；充能只在剪击实际命中后获得。
complete.en: Switch to Lycaon after charging completes and the released strike starts. Charges are granted only on the actual hit.

reason.zh: 作者明确给出蓄满→松开→切人的节点；仅将这一招剩余动作标为重叠。
reason.en: The author identifies full charge → release → switch. Only the remainder of that move is marked as overlapping.

fallback.zh: 不能确认蓄满或命中时先完整打完；空挥不补记充能。
fallback.en: If full charge/hit is uncertain, finish the move on field. A whiff grants no charges.

signal.zh: 蓄满且松开发动后普通切莱卡恩。
signal.en: Normal-switch to Lycaon after the fully charged strike starts.

title.zh: 莱卡恩命中刷新冰抗降低
title.en: Lycaon hit refreshes Ice RES reduction

input.zh: 有能量时发动强化特殊技，按实际能量选择蓄力。
input.en: Use EX Special with available energy; charge only when energy permits.

trigger.zh: 能量足够且目标可命中；普通特殊技不能代替这项减抗。
trigger.en: Enough energy and a hittable target. Normal Special does not replace this RES-reduction trigger.

complete.zh: 强化特殊技实际命中；未失衡时继续蓄力普攻推进，失衡后确认莱卡恩也命中过目标。
complete.en: Land the EX. Use charged Basics to advance Stun; ensure Lycaon also hits the target while it is Stunned.

reason.zh: 减冰抗和失衡易伤是两项不同条件，不能只因站在队里就算生效。
reason.en: Ice RES reduction and Stun multiplier have separate conditions; merely being in the team activates neither.

fallback.zh: 无能量可由真实招架后的支援突击刷新减抗；没有招架条件时用普攻，暂不计减抗。
fallback.en: An actual Defensive Assist follow-up can refresh RES reduction without EX. Without that opportunity, use Basics and do not assume the debuff.

label.zh: 蓄剪续招 · 仅已释放且尚未结束时
label.en: Scissor continuation · only released and still ongoing

input.zh: 能量允许时点按强化特殊技；每次发动后观察涡流。
input.en: Use EX Special as energy allows; read Vortex after each cast.

trigger.zh: 需要准备强化展旗；已有三层时可跳过积蓄。
trigger.en: Preparing an enhanced Fly the Flag; skip buildup if three stacks already exist.

complete.zh: 记录实际层数。两层加一次实际连携可到三层；不固定要求空放三个E。
complete.en: Read actual stacks. Two plus an actual Chain can reach three; three empty EX casts are not mandatory.

reason.zh: 强化展旗用三层；基础展旗本身不要求三层。
reason.en: Three stacks strengthen Fly the Flag; basic Fly the Flag does not require them.

fallback.zh: 能量不足不虚构涡流；可先用基础展旗，等后续实际连携补层。
fallback.en: Do not invent stacks when energy is short. Use basic Fly the Flag, then build through a later actual Chain.

title.zh: 展旗命中，把增益交给艾莲
title.en: Land Fly the Flag and transfer to Ellen

input.en: Hold Special for Fly the Flag.

trigger.zh: 苍角能发动展旗；若要强化效果，实际已有三层涡流。
trigger.en: Fly the Flag is available; enhanced effects require three actual Vortex stacks.

complete.zh: 展旗命中并出现艾莲快支提示；接下一步快支。
complete.en: Land Fly the Flag and wait for Ellen’s Quick Assist prompt, then take the next Assist step.

reason.zh: 攻击增益要通过对应快支/连携传递；普通切艾莲不视为已继承。
reason.en: ATK transfer requires the matching Quick Assist/Chain. A normal switch does not count.

fallback.zh: 提示不是艾莲则核对站位；没有命中或提示就不要记作传递成功。
fallback.en: Check slots if the prompt is not Ellen. Without the hit/prompt, do not credit a successful transfer.

signal.zh: 只有艾莲快支提示出现时接手。
signal.en: Enter only through Ellen’s actual Quick Assist prompt.

title.zh: 艾莲快支接增益与快蓄
title.en: Ellen Quick Assist receives the transfer and Quick Charge

input.zh: 在苍角的艾莲快支提示下按支援键。
input.en: Press Assist at Ellen’s Quick Assist prompt from Soukaku.

trigger.zh: 实际存在对应快支提示。
trigger.en: The matching Quick Assist prompt is visible.

complete.zh: 确认艾莲快支入场；缺急冻充能时利用快蓄再做巡游蓄剪。
complete.en: Confirm Ellen entered through Quick Assist. If charges are low, use Quick Charge for the next Roaming charged scissors.

reason.zh: 快蓄不等于已经获得充能，仍要蓄剪命中。
reason.en: Quick Charge is not a free Charge grant; the scissor attack must still hit.

fallback.zh: 错过提示则重新用展旗建立传递，不用普通换人冒充；紧急情况下先保证生存。
fallback.en: If the prompt is missed, re-establish the transfer with Fly the Flag; do not count a normal switch. Prioritize survival when needed.

objective.zh: 资源与增益缺哪补哪，避免每轮重复长准备。
objective.en: Refresh only missing resources/buffs rather than repeating long setup every loop.

title.zh: 展旗命中，把增益交给艾莲
title.en: Land Fly the Flag and transfer to Ellen

input.en: Hold Special for Fly the Flag.

trigger.zh: 苍角能发动展旗；若要强化效果，实际已有三层涡流。

title.zh: 艾莲快支接增益与快蓄
title.en: Ellen Quick Assist receives the transfer and Quick Charge

input.zh: 在苍角的艾莲快支提示下按支援键。
input.en: Press Assist at Ellen’s Quick Assist prompt from Soukaku.

trigger.zh: 实际存在对应快支提示。
trigger.en: The matching Quick Assist prompt is visible.

complete.zh: 确认艾莲快支入场；缺急冻充能时利用快蓄再做巡游蓄剪。

fallback.en: If the prompt is missed, re-establish the transfer with Fly the Flag; do not count a normal switch. Prioritize survival when needed.

input.zh: 有急冻充能时普攻；第三段可连点/长按延长。
input.en: Attack with Flash Freeze Charges; repeat/hold Basic to extend hit 3.

trigger.zh: 拥有实际急冻充能；EX后可直接接第三段。
trigger.en: Actual Flash Freeze Charges are available; EX can link directly into hit 3.

complete.zh: 关键第三段实际命中；消耗与补回的充能按当前界面检查。
complete.en: Land the key third hit; read actual charge consumption/refill on screen.

reason.zh: 输出与资源绑定，不能把无充能的物理普攻算作同一冰伤连段。
reason.en: This output is resource-bound; uncharged Physical Basics are not the same Ice string.

fallback.zh: 充能不足回巡游蓄剪；敌人攻击打断时先闪避，重新确认前提。
fallback.en: Return to Roaming charged scissors if short of charges. Dodge interruptions and recheck prerequisites.

objective.zh: 苍角先展旗，再交艾莲的冰伤连段。
objective.en: Let Soukaku apply Fly the Flag before Ellen’s Ice string.

prep.zh: 莱卡恩的失衡易伤需要命中已经失衡的目标；若由其他角色打失衡，先补上这次命中。
prep.en: Lycaon’s Stun multiplier requires hitting a Stunned target. If someone else caused Stun, land his required hit first.

title.en: Soukaku Chain into Fly the Flag

input.zh: 实际连携提示中选择苍角。
input.en: Select Soukaku at the actual Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 敌人已失衡；苍角连携可用，且莱卡恩已命中过失衡目标。
trigger.en: Enemy Stunned, Soukaku Chain available, and Lycaon has hit the Stunned target.

complete.zh: 连携获得一层涡流并衔接展旗；后续可选艾莲时再选艾莲连携。
complete.en: Chain adds one Vortex and links into Fly the Flag; select Ellen Chain only if the following prompt permits it.

reason.zh: 两层涡流可由本次连携补至三层；实际不足时不要算强化展旗。
reason.en: This Chain can bring two Vortex stacks to three; do not credit enhanced Fly the Flag otherwise.

fallback.zh: 无后续艾莲连携时按实际快支转艾莲，参考循环段的独立快支步骤。
fallback.en: If no Ellen Chain follows, use the actual Quick Assist and the separate loop Assist step.

signal.zh: 实际后续连携提示可选艾莲时接入。
signal.en: Select Ellen only if the actual following Chain prompt allows it.

title.en: Ellen Chain receives the flag transfer

input.zh: 在苍角之后的连携提示选择艾莲。
input.en: Select Ellen at the Chain prompt after Soukaku.

trigger.zh: 艾莲连携确实可选，且苍角已完成本次展旗。
trigger.en: Ellen Chain is available and Soukaku’s Fly the Flag has occurred.

complete.zh: 确认连携入场并获得传递；按实际连携选择结束后留艾莲输出。
complete.en: Confirm Chain entry and the transfer, then finish the chosen Chain sequence with Ellen dealing damage.

reason.zh: 不能普通切艾莲就补记传递；是否多打一段连携按敌人和剩余窗口决定。
reason.en: A normal switch does not credit the transfer. More Chains depend on the enemy and remaining window.

fallback.zh: 本步不可选时走实际快支分支；不要强行补一段不存在的连携。
fallback.en: Use the actual Quick Assist branch if this step is unavailable; do not invent a Chain.

title.en: Land Tail Swipe and link into hit 3

input.zh: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技，再接普攻。
input.en: Press EX Special with enough energy, then Basic.

trigger.zh: 能量足够、目标可命中、窗口仍在。
trigger.en: Enough energy, a hittable target, and the window remains.

complete.zh: 横扫命中获得一点充能，下一步直接接第三段。
complete.en: Tail Swipe hits and grants one Charge; next, link directly into hit 3.

reason.zh: 0影可执行的基础EA衔接，不需要专武或2影。
reason.en: This base EX-to-Basic link works at M0 without a signature or M2.

fallback.zh: 无能量时用已有充能普攻；没有充能先蓄剪。
fallback.en: Without energy, use charged Basics; without Charges, use charged scissors.

input.zh: 有急冻充能时普攻；第三段可连点/长按延长。
input.en: Attack with Flash Freeze Charges; repeat/hold Basic to extend hit 3.

trigger.zh: 拥有实际急冻充能；EX后可直接接第三段。
trigger.en: Actual Flash Freeze Charges are available; EX can link directly into hit 3.

complete.zh: 关键第三段实际命中；消耗与补回的充能按当前界面检查。
complete.en: Land the key third hit; read actual charge consumption/refill on screen.

reason.zh: 输出与资源绑定，不能把无充能的物理普攻算作同一冰伤连段。
reason.en: This output is resource-bound; uncharged Physical Basics are not the same Ice string.

fallback.zh: 充能不足回巡游蓄剪；敌人攻击打断时先闪避，重新确认前提。
fallback.en: Return to Roaming charged scissors if short of charges. Dodge interruptions and recheck prerequisites.

input.zh: 第三段急冻普攻后，能量足够时接强化特殊技。
input.en: After Flash Freeze Basic hit 3, use EX Special with enough energy.

trigger.zh: 艾莲至少2影；第三段刚完成，能量足够且衔接仍有效。
trigger.en: Ellen M2 or higher; hit 3 just completed, enough energy, and the link remains available.

complete.zh: 鲨卷风实际命中；后续仍可按资源接第三段。
complete.en: Land Sharknami; link into hit 3 again only as resources allow.

reason.zh: 此直接衔接由2影开放；0影必须遵守先横扫再鲨卷风的基础前提。
reason.en: M2 unlocks this direct link. M0 must first meet the base Tail Swipe → Sharknami prerequisite.

fallback.zh: 不足2影不执行；缺能量或衔接失效则回常态资源检查。
fallback.en: Do not execute below M2. Recheck resources if energy is short or the link expires.

title.zh: 可选：就绪且窗口仍在再开终结技
title.en: Optional: use a ready Ultimate while the window remains

input.zh: 艾莲自身终结技可用时点按终结技。
input.en: Press Ellen’s own Ultimate when ready.

trigger.zh: 终结技已就绪、目标可命中，增益与实际输出窗口仍有效。
trigger.en: Ultimate ready, target hittable, and buffs/output window still active.

complete.zh: 实际命中后重新检查急冻充能与敌人状态。
complete.en: After the hit, recheck Charges and enemy state.

reason.zh: 不沿用开服全队共用喧响，也不保证排在此处是最优时点。
reason.en: The launch-era shared Decibel rule is not used, and this placement is not claimed optimal.

fallback.zh: 未就绪或窗口结束直接跳过，回常态循环。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable or the window ends, then return to the loop.

text.zh: 艾莲M1的快速/蓄力剪击命中分别给3/6点充能；按真实层数减少补资源次数。
text.en: At M1, quick/charged scissor hits grant three/six Charges. Reduce refill actions according to the actual gauge.

text.zh: M4在队伍中任意角色实际施加冻结或使敌人失衡时补充能与快蓄；条件未发生时不得提前算满。
text.en: M4 grants Charges/Quick Charge when any squad member actually applies Freeze or Stun; do not pre-credit the refill.

text.zh: 深海访客的普攻命中与冰伤冲刺攻击是两项独立触发，按实际命中确认覆盖。
text.en: Deep Sea Visitor has separate Basic-hit and Ice Dash-Attack triggers; check both against actual hits.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.展旗命中，把增益交给艾莲: 长按特殊技展旗，命中后交棒

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.2影可选：第三段后鲨卷风: 2影可选：第三段急冻普攻后接强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：就绪且窗口仍在再开终结技: 可选：窗口仍在时可用终结技

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.进入巡游，长按普攻蓄满，松开让剪击发动。: 先进入巡游，再长按普攻蓄满并松开。看到剪击出手再交棒。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时点按强化特殊技，再接普攻。: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，命中后点普攻接第三段。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.113100005: 长按特殊技展旗，等挥击命中

114100001: 走蓄力普攻路线：每段按住至蓄力完成再松开衔接，不按固定次数解锁强化特殊技。
For this charged Basic route hold and release each charged hit; there is no fixed tap count to unlock EX.
119100002: 本步用急冻普攻；打到第三段时可连点或长按延长，不要求每段都长按。
Use the ice-enhanced Basic here; at hit 3, repeated taps or a hold can extend it. Holding every hit is not required.
119100006: 强化特殊技前不用普攻；本路线出招后点普攻直接接第三段，不是再从头打三段。
No Basic required before EX. After EX, link directly into Basic hit 3 on this route; do not start a new three-hit string.
119100007: 仅2影及以上的这条捷径：先完成第三段急冻普攻，再点强化特殊技直达鲨卷风。普通路线也可在横扫后接，不要求先打普攻。
M2+ shortcut only: finish ice-enhanced Basic hit 3, then tap EX for Sharknami. The regular EX Sweep follow-up does not require a Basic opener.
119100010: 先进入巡游，长按普攻蓄满后松开，不用为起手先点数段普攻。
Enter Roaming, hold Basic to full charge and release. No preceding Basic taps are required.
